items.headline: IMF Warns Global Economic Resilience Is Nearing Its Limits
items.summary: The International Monetary Fund released its latest World Economic Outlook at its annual meeting, warning that global economic resilience is under strain as financial buffers wear thin. The Fund highlighted mounting risks to worldwide growth from escalating energy prices, high government debt, and persistent geopolitical conflicts.

items.headline: SpaceX Launches NASA Resupply Mission Carrying Solar Arrays and Science Experiments
items.summary: On October 13, 2026, SpaceX launched its 35th commercial resupply mission for NASA to the International Space Station from Cape Canaveral. The Falcon 9 rocket carried over 6,300 pounds of cargo, including the space station's final pair of roll-out solar arrays and new biological research experiments.

items.headline: Top Seed Alexander Zverev Edges Alexander Bublik in Shanghai Masters Thriller
items.summary: World No. 1 Alexander Zverev secured a hard-fought 7-6, 4-6, 7-6 victory over Alexander Bublik on Tuesday to advance to the Shanghai Masters quarter-finals. The victory keeps the top-seeded German on track in the prestigious ATP Masters 1000 event as the hard-court swing reaches its closing stages.

items.headline: Former Gang Leader Sentenced to 40 Years to Life in 1996 Murder of Tupac Shakur
items.summary: On October 13, 2026, former gang leader Duane "Keffe D" Davis was sentenced in a Nevada court to 40 years to life in prison for orchestrating the 1996 drive-by shooting of rap icon Tupac Shakur. The ruling brings final legal accountability to one of the most famous cold cases in music history following Davis's conviction earlier this year.
